derived_conflicts.description: tracks the pipeline predicts a conflict with (rule-derived)

derived_min_ttc_s.description: the pipeline's minimum time to collision over all tracks (rule-derived: a model given it can copy the rule)

ego_acceleration_mps2.description: speed change since the previous processed frame; null on a run's first

ego_heading_deg.description: ego heading, counter-clockwise from the world +x axis

ego_lane.description: lane index reported by the producer (Webots: 0 the kerb-side driving lane, 2 next to the median)

ego_lane_change.description: the producer reports a lane change in progress

follower_age_s.description: follower vehicle: time since the track was first seen

follower_lat_m.description: follower vehicle: lateral position, positive left

follower_lon_m.description: follower vehicle: longitudinal position relative to the ego rear axle, positive ahead

follower_present.description: follower vehicle: a confirmed track is in the slot (the other slot fields are null when not)

follower_range_rate_mps.description: follower vehicle: radar range rate; null when the radar gave none

follower_unseen_s.description: follower vehicle: time since the track was last measured (0 when measured in this frame)

follower_v_lon_mps.description: follower vehicle: relative longitudinal velocity, negative closing from ahead

hazard_ahead_distance_m.description: longitudinal distance to the nearest one

hazard_ahead_present.description: an ACTIVE mapped hazard ahead in the ego lane

hazards_ahead_100m.description: ACTIVE mapped hazards ahead within 100 m in the ego or an adjacent lane

history_dropped_before.description: states between them that the history layer itself dropped

lead_age_s.description: lead vehicle: time since the track was first seen

lead_lat_m.description: lead vehicle: lateral position, positive left

lead_lon_m.description: lead vehicle: longitudinal position relative to the ego rear axle, positive ahead

lead_present.description: lead vehicle: a confirmed track is in the slot (the other slot fields are null when not)

lead_range_rate_mps.description: lead vehicle: radar range rate; null when the radar gave none

lead_unseen_s.description: lead vehicle: time since the track was last measured (0 when measured in this frame)

lead_v_lon_mps.description: lead vehicle: relative longitudinal velocity, negative closing from ahead

left_age_s.description: left vehicle: time since the track was first seen

left_lane_driving.description: a driving lane exists to the ego's left (road geometry)

left_lat_m.description: left vehicle: lateral position, positive left

left_lon_m.description: left vehicle: longitudinal position relative to the ego rear axle, positive ahead

left_present.description: left vehicle: a confirmed track is in the slot (the other slot fields are null when not)

left_range_rate_mps.description: left vehicle: radar range rate; null when the radar gave none

left_unseen_s.description: left vehicle: time since the track was last measured (0 when measured in this frame)

left_v_lon_mps.description: left vehicle: relative longitudinal velocity, negative closing from ahead

right_age_s.description: right vehicle: time since the track was first seen

right_lane_driving.description: a driving lane exists to the ego's right (road geometry)

right_lat_m.description: right vehicle: lateral position, positive left

right_lon_m.description: right vehicle: longitudinal position relative to the ego rear axle, positive ahead

right_present.description: right vehicle: a confirmed track is in the slot (the other slot fields are null when not)

right_range_rate_mps.description: right vehicle: radar range rate; null when the radar gave none

right_unseen_s.description: right vehicle: time since the track was last measured (0 when measured in this frame)

right_v_lon_mps.description: right vehicle: relative longitudinal velocity, negative closing from ahead

sequence_gap_before.description: sequence numbers between this state and the previous state the history saw that the processor never accepted; null for a segment's first

sim_dt_s.description: simulation time since the previous state the history saw; null for a segment's first
